The rule: the photo is refused if any signal fails, with reasons reported in order spark → calibration → segmentation and the message built as the reason details plus the re-upload advice. Calibration below 0.5 fails (no scale); SAM below 0.3 fails (ignored when `None`, i.e. before SAM runs); Spark "not a tray" at confidence ≥ 0.5 refuses on its own, while an unsure one (< 0.5) only counts when calibration is below 0.7 or SAM below 0.5. A Spark "is a tray" or missing Spark never refuses. Confidences outside 0–1 raise `ValueError`.
